articles.title: Palantir Earnings Send Stock Sharply Higher - Barron's
articles.description: Shares of Palantir Technologies rose sharply in late trading on Monday after the company reported strong second-quarter earnings results.
articles.content:
Shares ofPalantirTechnologies were up 12% in late trading Monday after the company reported strong second-quarter earnings results.
